${recipe.title}

${recipe.instructions}

Ingredients

    ${JSON.parse(recipe.ingredients).map(ing => `
  • ${ing}
    • `).join('')}
`; html += `

Average Rating: ${avgRating}

Comments

    ${comments.map(c => `
  • ${c.comment}
    • `).join('')}
`; res.status(200).send(html); }); }); }); app.post('/recipes/:recipeId/comments', (req, res) => { const { recipeId } = req.params; const { comment } = req.body; if (!comment) { return res.status(400).send('Invalid input'); } db.run(`INSERT INTO comments (recipeId, comment) VALUES (?, ?)`, [recipeId, comment], function(err) { if (err) { return res.status(404).send('Recipe not found'); } res.status(201).send('Comment added successfully'); }); }); app.post('/recipes/:recipeId/ratings', (req, res) => { const { recipeId } = req.params; const { rating } = req.body; if (!rating || rating < 1 || rating > 5) { return res.status(400).send('Invalid input'); } db.run(`INSERT INTO ratings (recipeId, rating) VALUES (?, ?)`, [recipeId, rating], function(err) { if (err) { return res.status(404).send('Recipe not found'); } db.get(`SELECT AVG(rating) as avgRating FROM ratings WHERE recipeId = ?`, [recipeId], (err, row) => { if (err) { return res.status(500).send('Server error'); } db.run(`UPDATE recipes SET avgRating = ? WHERE id = ?`, [row.avgRating, recipeId]); res.status(201).send('Rating added successfully'); }); }); }); // Start server app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => { console.log(`Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`); });
critic:
The discussion between the correctness and safety critics highlights significant concerns regarding the proposed system solution for managing recipes. The correctness critic acknowledges that the solution adheres to the OpenAPI schema and implements necessary API endpoints, but points out flaws in error handling that could mislead users about the reasons for failures in comment and rating submissions. Specifically, the critic notes that the system incorrectly reports non-existent recipes as the sole reason for insertion failures, which could confuse users.

On the other hand, the safety critic raises critical issues regarding security vulnerabilities. The lack of input validation and sanitization for user-generated content poses a risk of SQL injection attacks, which could compromise the database and expose sensitive information. Additionally, the absence of authentication and authorization mechanisms allows unrestricted access to the system, increasing the risk of abuse and the introduction of malicious content. The critic also warns about potential data integrity issues related to the use of `JSON.stringify` for ingredients.

In summary, while the solution demonstrates some functional correctness, it is not completely correct or secure. The identified issues with error handling, input validation, and lack of access controls indicate that the solution does not fully satisfy the requirements for safety and correctness. To achieve a robust and secure system, it is essential to address these vulnerabilities by implementing proper error handling, input validation, and authentication mechanisms, ensuring that the solution adheres to security standards and protects both the system and its users.
